svg.title: Pac-man eats the last 12 months of contributions
svg.desc: The real GitHub contribution grid for the last 12 months — 1318 contributions over 131 active days, peak day 52 on Jul 4 — with an animated pac-man eating it row by row while four ghosts give chase.
svg.text: ● power pellet = peak day · 52 on Jul 4 | 131 active days | longest streak 12 days
